newsitem.title: CHINA: SHANGHAI EXTENDS COPPER, ALUMINIUM TRADING TIME.
newsitem.headline: SHANGHAI EXTENDS COPPER, ALUMINIUM TRADING TIME.

text.p: The Shanghai Metal Exchange will extend the trading time of its copper and aluminium contracts from Monday, August 11, an exchange statement said on Thursday.

Aluminium trading hours would be extended from the former four sessions daily to six sessions, it said, with the new morning session from 10.30 to 10.55 a.m. (0230-0255 GMT) and the new afternoon session from 2.20 p.m. to 3 p.m. (0620-0700 GMT), it said.
A second afternoon copper trading session would be added, from 1.30 p.m. to 2.10 p.m. (0530-0610 GMT), it said.
Currently each metal trades in three morning sessions and one afternoon session.
Local traders said the new sessions were being added because most investors expected aluminium prices on the London Metal Exchange (LME) to rise later this year.

As prices on the Shanghai Metal Exchange largely plot the course of the LME, extending local hours gave Shanghai investors a greater chance to follow the international market, the trading sources said.
